q: The category Meas of measurable spaces has objects (X,Σ) and morphisms measurable functions. The category of standard Borel spaces (with Borel morphisms) is particularly well-behaved because:
opts: It has all limits and colimits
It embeds fully faithfully into the category of Polish spaces, and standard Borel spaces are closed under countable limits/colimits
exp: Standard Borel spaces (Borel σ-algebra of a Polish space) form a well-behaved category: closed under countable products, countable disjoint unions, Borel subsets. The Borel isomorphism theorem: any two uncountable standard Borel spaces are isomorphic (as Borel spaces).
